activation.authentication: tenant-scoped bearer token with issuers:write and Idempotency-Key
activation.fail_closed: all HTTP protocol mounts return 503 and the SPIFFE UDS remains absent until activation
activation.tenant_isolation: a bearer principal for any tenant other than protocols.eval_tenant_id receives 403 and cannot open the gate
activation.durability: one protocol.eval_profile.activated event for the configured tenant reopens the exact profile after buildRunDeps and Build are run again

interop.acme: RFC 8555 account registration, order, HTTP-01 authorization, finalize, and certificate download through a digest-signer-backed stock x/crypto/acme client
interop.est: RFC 7030 authenticated simpleenroll carrying a PKCS#10 request and returning certs-only PKCS#7
interop.scep: RFC 8894 GetCACert plus Intune-challenge-authenticated CMS PKIOperation and decrypted CertRep
interop.cmp: RFC 4210/6712 signed p10cr PKIMessage and protected certificate response
interop.ssh: OpenSSH user certificate issue plus served CA authority key
interop.spiffe: SPIFFE Workload API FetchX509SVID over the served Unix-domain gRPC socket with the mandatory security metadata

independent_verification.x509: OpenSSL verifies ACME, EST, SCEP, CMP, and SPIFFE leaves against the served signer-backed CA
independent_verification.est: OpenSSL parses the returned DER PKCS#7 certificate set
independent_verification.scep_cmp: OpenSSL ASN.1 parses both wire requests and responses
independent_verification.ssh: ssh-keygen parses the issued user certificate and the served CA key
independent_verification.tsa: openssl ts parses and verifies the TimeStampResp against the exact request and served CA
independent_verification.spiffe: OpenSSL verifies the URI SAN and trust bundle while the in-process stock client proves the ephemeral private-key field is present without persisting that key in evidence

completion: passed requires all seven post-activation round trips, one-tenant fail-closed behavior, exact event/read-model evidence, independent artifact validation, and all seven post-restart readbacks
